name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A free set of ready-made add-ons that turn an AI assistant into a specialist for a specific job — sales, HR, finance — already wired up to tools like Slack and Notion.
buyer: An operations lead at a small or mid-size company who wants their team using AI consistently, with the right tools and process, instead of everyone improvising their own prompts.
business_use_cases: A consulting shop customizes these plugins with a client's own terminology and tools, then sells the setup as an 'AI onboarding' package.
A company's ops team adopts the sales or productivity plugin to standardize how reps use AI across the team.
An agency builds a niche vertical plugin (e.g. for real estate or accounting) modeled on this repo's structure and sells it as a packaged product.

money_ideas.idea: Sell 'AI plugin setup and customization' as a consulting service for small companies adopting Claude.
Build and sell a niche industry plugin not covered by the open-source set.

steal_this: Pick one of the 11 plugins, customize it this weekend with a specific small business's tools and jargon, and sell the setup as a half-day consulting package.
